plan.summary:
Export `RetryPolicy` from the public entry points of the TypeScript package and the Rust core crate, so library users can build their own retry policy.

- `src/index.ts` re-exports `RetryPolicy` and the `RetryOptions` type from `./retry`.
- `crates/core/src/lib.rs` re-exports `retry::RetryPolicy` at the crate root.
- Both changes only add exports. The retry code itself is not changed in this diff.
plan.riskRationale: Two one-line additions to the public API. No logic changes. The risk is that the exported names become part of the public API contract.
plan.storyArc: One goal: make the retry policy reachable from the public API in both languages. One topic covers both re-exports.

topics.title: Export RetryPolicy from the public API
topics.narrativeBrief: What new public names can library users import? Compare the TypeScript re-export, which also exports the RetryOptions type, with the Rust re-export, which exports only RetryPolicy. Check whether RetryOptions has a Rust equivalent that is left out.
